invariants.rationale: The method returns an Iterator, which is always constructed and never explicitly null.
If recordItr has elements, result is an instance of JavaLazyInsertIterable (per the method's return statements).
If recordItr is empty, result yields exactly one empty list.
If recordItr has elements, the returned iterator should be non-empty.
idPfx is always passed unconditionally to the returned iterable/factory, so it may be null, but its value propagates to the result.
